title: Mining
summary: Mine the Coal Mine, Gold Mine and Deep Caverns for Mining XP, ore and collections; Mining Speed and Mining Fortune; the Mine Merchant and mining minions.

s.x: Mining levels by breaking stone and ore. The Mining skill is Hypixel SkyBlock's: 60 levels, the
Spelunker
perk (+4 Mining Fortune a level) and +1 Defense a level (+2 from level 15). See
Skills overview
for the XP curve and what each level pays.
Stone and ore only break in the mining areas. A broken block turns to bedrock for a few seconds, then comes back, so the ore never runs out.

s.x: The Deep Caverns' six layers each have their own ore:
The rarer the block, the longer it takes to grow back: Stone and Coal Ore 4 to 6 seconds, Gold Ore and Diamond Ore 8, Obsidian 20, Diamond Blocks 30. Your own
island
has no ore to mine, but a
minion
can mine for you there.
Deepslate versions pay the same. Sand, Gravel and Diamond Blocks pay nothing. Blocks you placed yourself never pay XP, and neither do minions: only what you break with your own hands counts.
What you mine fills the Mining
collections
: Cobblestone, Coal, Gold Ingot, Iron Ingot, Redstone, Diamond, Emerald, Obsidian, Gravel, Sand and the rest of the 25. Each tier unlocks recipes in the
Recipe Book
: Cobblestone I opens the Cobblestone Minion, Cobblestone IV the Enchanted Cobblestone. Items you collect from your minions count too.

rows.x: Breaks blocks faster. Pickaxes and some armour carry it.
Each full 100 drops the ore's items one more time, and the rest is the chance of one more. It counts for ores, not for Stone or Obsidian. The Spelunker perk gives +4 a level.
Shown on pickaxes, but nothing checks it yet.
